text: On the SH4 between Levan and Tepelenë and right by the Greek border, you may see **double outer road lines** with a wide gap between them.
text_zh: 在勒萬（Levan）和特佩萊納（Tepelenë）之間的 SH4 道路上，以及希臘邊境附近，你可能會看到間隔很寬的 **雙層外側道路標線**。

text: **Pedestrian signs** have a unique design: instead of zebra stripes, they have two horizontal dashed lines.
NOTE: All neighbouring countries have pedestrian signs with zebra stripes.
text_zh: **行人標誌**有獨特的設計：它們沒有斑馬線，而是兩條水平虛線。
註：所有鄰國的行人標誌都有斑馬線圖案。

text: Roads in Brazil will usually feature **double yellow** middle lines, with white outer lines. Roads can occasionally have a [single dashed yellow line](https://goo.gl/maps/c8XDntyn1zgp9gah9).
text_zh: 巴西的道路通常帶有**雙黃**中央線與白色外側線。道路偶爾會有[單黃虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/c8XDntyn1zgp9gah9)。

text: **Cobblestone pavement** is most common in the northeast and in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: **石塊路面**在東北部和南里奧格蘭德州最常見。

text: Roads with **hexagonal** concrete tiles can be found across Brazil, but they are more common in Santa Catarina and Minas Gerais.
text_zh: 鋪有**六角形**混凝土磚的路面在巴西各地都能找到，但在聖卡塔琳娜州和米納斯吉拉斯州更為常見。

text: Some roads in Acre are made of **red brick**.
text_zh: 阿克里州的部分道路是由**紅磚**鋪成的。

text: Cobblestone roads with **randomly sized stones** are most common in southeast Rio Grande do Sul and Minas Gerais.
text_zh: 由**大小不一石塊**鋪成的鵝卵石路在南里奧格蘭德州東南部和米納斯吉拉斯州最常見。

text: These **uneven** but mostly **square** stone roads are seen in western Rio Grande do Sul and west Santa Catarina. The soil will often be very dark in these regions too.
NOTE: The same roads are seen in the Misiones province of Argentina.
text_zh: 這些**高低不平**但大多呈**方形**的石路可見於南里奧格蘭德州西部和聖卡塔琳娜州西部。這些地區的土壤通常也非常深色。
註：阿根廷米西奧內斯省（Misiones）也有相同的道路。

text: You can often see pavements in Rio Grande do Sul that have **brown tiles** but are either jagged and random, or square. This style can sometimes be seen in Santa Catarina.
text_zh: 你經常可以在南里奧格蘭德州看到帶有**棕色地磚**的人行道，這些地磚要麼參差不齊且隨機排列，要麼呈方形。這種風格有時在聖卡塔琳娜州也能看到。

text: Many roads in Piauí have **red gravel **on the side of the road. The gravel can appear spread [above the tarmac shoulder](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A3k1mmWsApnmRQpU9) or on roads with curbs.
NOTE: This can appear elsewhere. Use with caution.
text_zh: 皮奧伊州的許多道路旁都有**紅砂礫**。砂礫可能鋪在[瀝青路肩上](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A3k1mmWsApnmRQpU9)或出現在有路緣石的道路上。
注意：這也可能出現在其他地方，請謹慎使用。

text: Canadian roads usually have **single yellow **centre lines. However, double middle yellow centre lines are still decently common.
NOTE: Double yellow centre lines are more common in the US. This is not a 100% reliable clue, so make sure to use this along with other clues.
text_zh: 加拿大的道路通常有**單黃線 **中央標線。不過，雙黃線中央標線依然相當常見。
註：雙黃線中央標線在美國更為常見。這不是一個 100% 完全可靠的線索，因此請務必搭配其他線索一起使用。

text: Within Eastern Canada, **double yellow lines** are most common in Nova Scotia, followed by Québec and Prince Edward Island. Ontario prefers single yellow lines for this purpose, but will occasionally use them.
_For some empirical research, please see this [document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/15DuGdsvKMqv5O-XiFwhNuczw89jVqg8XycY7brvhjP4/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.vhodl2gtolwe)._
text_zh: 在加拿大東部，**雙黃線**最常見於新斯科細亞省，其次是魁北克省和愛德華王子島。安大略省在相同用途上更偏好單黃線，但偶爾也會使用雙黃線。
_欲了解一些實證研究，請參閱這份[文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/15DuGdsvKMqv5O-XiFwhNuczw89jVqg8XycY7brvhjP4/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.vhodl2gtolwe)。_

text: You can sometimes find **white dashes** between the yellow centre lines in Saskatchewan.
text_zh: 在薩克其萬省，有時可以在黃色中央標線之間看到**白色虛線**。

text: Rumble strips **in the centre of the road **(generally over the roadlines) are most common in Alberta and British Columbia.
text_zh: **位於路中央**的減速震動線（通常位於道路標線上）在亞伯達省與英屬哥倫比亞省最為常見。

text: Roadlines with **dotted paint** are common in Los Ríos and Aysén.
text_zh: 帶有**虛線漆**的路面標線常見於洛斯里奧斯和艾森。

text: From the “Route 32 Toll” close to the San José and Heredia border until where it intersects RN 4 west of Guapiles, the road uses yellow bollards placed between the centre road lines.
text_zh: 從靠近聖荷西與埃雷迪亞邊界的「32號公路收費站」直到它在瓜皮萊斯以西與 4 號國道交叉口為止，該道路在中央道路標線之間使用了黃色路樁。

text: Pedestrian crossing signs in France have five stripes and a disconnected head on the person. They have the usual white border of French traffic signs.
Less commonly, you can find a design with [two dashed lines](https://goo.gl/maps/iD7GdGUA7Ew3h8oa7) instead of stripes.
text_zh: 法國的人行穿越道標誌有五條條紋，且行人的頭部是分離的。它們帶有法國交通標誌常見的白色邊框。
較少見的情況是，你可以找到採用[兩條虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/iD7GdGUA7Ew3h8oa7)而非條紋設計的標誌。

text: Typical French roads have long spaced out dashes on the outside.
text_zh: 典型的法國道路外側有間距較長的短標線。

text: These middle road lines, where each dash consists of two **offset blocks**, are unique to France. They are not extremely common, but when you see them, you can safely guess France.
text_zh: 這些中間的道路標線，每個短劃由兩個**偏移區塊**組成，是法國特有的。它們雖然不是非常普遍，但只要看到，你就可以大膽猜測是法國。

text: Middle lines with **dashes that are longer than usual** can be a good clue for France.
NOTE: Unusually long dashes are also common in the UK.
text_zh: 中心標線的**短劃比平常更長**，這可以作為法國很好的線索。
注意：異常長的短劃在英國也很常見。

text: These arrows on the road signalling the end of a passing zone are only found in a couple of European countries, including France. In France, the middle dashes will be very close together in these areas.

NOTE: Other countries where this style of arrow can be found are Spain, Portugal and Romania. These arrows can also be found in the UK, but they will point towards the left lane instead of the right one.
text_zh: 這些標示超車道結束的道路箭頭只在少數歐洲國家（包括法國）出現。在法國，這些區域的中間短劃會非常密集。
注意：可以找到這種風格箭頭的其他國家還有西班牙、葡萄牙和羅馬尼亞。這些箭頭在英國也能找到，但它們會指向左側車道而不是右側車道。

text: Indonesia uses **white or yellow** centre lines. Outer lines will always be white. The centre lines will be solid or dashed.
In Generation 3 coverage, yellow centre lines are more rare, as Indonesia only recently started using this colour for its road lines.
NOTE: Malaysian road lines are always all white.
text_zh: 印尼使用**白色或黃色**中心線。外側標線一律為白色。中心線可以是實線或虛線。
在第 3 相機世代的街景覆蓋中，黃色中心線較為罕見，因為印尼直到最近才開始在其道路標線中使用這種顏色。
注意：馬來西亞的道路標線一律全為白色。

text: One of the most common types of Italian road lines are **white solid outer lines** with no middle line. This is generally less common in other Mediterranean countries.
text_zh: 義大利最常見的道路標線之一是沒有中間線的**白色實線外緣線**。這在其他地中海國家通常較少見。

text: Outer lines in Kenya will always be solid white, while inner lines will be yellow and either solid or dashed.
text_zh: 肯亞的外側道路標線永遠是實心白線，內側則是黃線且為實線或虛線。

text: If you see **black and yellow **striped kerbs, you are most likely to be in Strumica.
They are rarely found in Skopje and if you see them around [roundabouts](https://goo.gl/maps/j2jezBcXn9vjeEh46), you will most likely be in Tetovo.
text_zh: 如果你看到**黑黃**相間的路緣，你很可能是身在斯特魯米察。
它們在斯科普里很少見，如果你在[圓環](https://goo.gl/maps/j2jezBcXn9vjeEh46)周圍看到它們，你很可能是身在泰托沃。

text: Panama features a diverse set of road lines, but the most common combination is [solid outer white with an inner yellow line](https://goo.gl/maps/KAGUqGk3zVKLnNXH8). However, those are not unique to Panama. Within Latin America, solid outer white lines with no middle line are almost unique to Panama.
text_zh: 巴拿馬有各種不同的道路標線，但最常見的組合是[外側實線白線搭配內側黃線](https://goo.gl/maps/KAGUqGk3zVKLnNXH8)。然而，這些並非巴拿馬獨有。在拉丁美洲內，只有外側實線白線且沒有中間線的情況幾乎是巴拿馬特有的。

text: **Bollards **in Qatar are only found on a few roads, and you can easily tell them apart.
- The horizontal [road just west of Qatar map label](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gTG4kNoWi6Nvgzgd9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) uses black and yellow centre lines.
- The horizontal [road south of Madinat al Ka`ban](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8zw6N5R1F83nVcoE7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) has a lot more greenery and, the coverage is also very overcast.
- The [coastal road south of Fuwayrit](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TccRhQzayTorZkmP9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) has coastal shrubs all around, and you can often see the coast.
- If the road doesn’t fit the above descriptions, guess on [the long vertical road west of Qatar map label](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zc4PecYmyuGQXYju7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng).
text_zh: 卡達的**路樁**僅在少數幾條道路上找到，你可以輕鬆地將它們區分開來。
- 位於 [Qatar 地圖標籤正西方的橫向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gTG4kNoWi6Nvgzgd9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 使用黑黃相間的中心線。
- [Madinat al Ka`ban 南側的橫向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8zw6N5R1F83nVcoE7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 有更多綠色植物，且街景覆蓋非常陰暗多雲。
- [Fuwayrit 南側的沿海道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TccRhQzayTorZkmP9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 周圍環繞著海岸灌木叢，且經常可以看到海岸線。
- 如果道路不符合上述描述，請猜 [Qatar 地圖標籤西側的長縱向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zc4PecYmyuGQXYju7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)。

text: Along with containing a large number of bollards, many intersections are **unusually wide** compared to other countries.
text_zh: 除了包含大量路樁之外，許多路口與其他國家相比也**異常寬闊**。

text: **Outer dashed road lines** are usually found throughout Kursk Oblast. An exception can be found in [Tuva Republic](https://goo.gl/maps/h6GYSQrhjBXDWJD39). Rarer exceptions include [the Republic of Karelia](https://goo.gl/maps/PvQvkaH63nHGqvD17), [Primorsky Krai](https://goo.gl/maps/6pXTrSNjaNmVToYF8) and [Khabarovsk Krai](https://goo.gl/maps/34mpJJfXMNBqKnJm9).
text_zh: **外側虛線道路標線**通常遍布庫斯克州。[圖瓦共和國](https://goo.gl/maps/h6GYSQrhjBXDWJD39)可找到一個例外。更罕見的例外包含[卡累利阿共和國](https://goo.gl/maps/PvQvkaH63nHGqvD17)、[濱海邊疆區](https://goo.gl/maps/6pXTrSNjaNmVToYF8)與[哈巴羅夫斯克邊疆區](https://goo.gl/maps/34mpJJfXMNBqKnJm9)。

text: As you go further north in Russia, some roads are made out of several **concrete blocks**. It is notably common in the Komi Republic, Nenets, and Yamalo-Nenets.
text_zh: 當你往俄羅斯更北方走時，有些道路是由數個**混凝土塊**組成的。這在科米共和國、涅涅茨與亞馬爾-涅涅茨尤為常見。

text: The NR11 north of Mabanza uses **all white road lines**.
text_zh: 馬班扎（Mabanza）以北的 NR11 使用**全白色道路標線**。

text: The section of NR15 from Muhanga till the Western Province border has very **poor pavement**, with a lot of potholes and a lack of road lines.
text_zh: NR15 從穆漢加（Muhanga）到西部省邊界的這段路面狀況**非常差**，有許多坑洞且缺乏道路標線。

text: The section of NR15 from the Western Province border to [this point](https://maps.app.goo.gl/g4dL5u31ULbJrdXw9) is under construction, with no pavement at the moment; making it the only covered National Road to be unpaved for this long. Also, most of the road hugs a steep cliffside made of red dirt.
NOTE: Non-national roads are often unpaved, but they are usually not as wide, and have more stuff going on around them.
text_zh: NR15 從西部省省界到[這個地點](https://maps.app.goo.gl/g4dL5u31ULbJrdXw9)的路段目前正在施工中，暫時沒有鋪裝路面；使其成為唯一一條長期未鋪裝的國道。此外，大部分道路都緊鄰由紅土構成的陡峭懸崖邊。
注意：非國道通常是未鋪裝道路，但它們通常沒那麼寬，且周圍的環境元素比較雜亂。

text: The NR16 is the only road that predominantly uses **dashed **outer white lines.
NOTE: Dashes are also used to indicate intersections elsewhere.
text_zh: NR16 是唯一主要使用**虛線**外側白線的道路。
注意：虛線在其他地方也用於表示交叉路口。

text: Many roads in **Butare** feature **cobblestone pavement**.
text_zh: **布塔雷（Butare）**的許多道路都採用**鵝卵石路面**。

text: Four-lane divided highways with **no divider**, other than double middle road lines, are almost exclusively found in the eastern half of the country.
Beware that divided highways with [clear dividers](https://goo.gl/maps/SLzhkGpReMShmtDt9), such as guardrails, can still be found in the east.
text_zh: 雙向四車道且 **沒有分隔島**（僅有雙黃線道路標線）的分隔公路，幾乎只分佈在該國的東半部。
請注意，在東部仍然可以找到帶有[清晰分隔設施](https://goo.gl/maps/SLzhkGpReMShmtDt9)（例如護欄）的分隔公路。

text: The US uses **yellow middle lines** and white outer lines. Double middle lines are the most common.
On divided roads, the outer line closest to the median will be yellow, and the other lines will usually be white.
NOTE: Double middle lines are less common in Canada, but not rare – use this meta with caution. Furthermore, yellow road lines are very rare in Europe.
text_zh: 美國使用**黃色中線**與白色外線。雙黃中線是最常見的。
在分向道路上，最靠近中央分隔帶的外線會是黃色的，其餘線條通常是白色的。
注意：雙中線在加拿大較少見，但也非絕無僅有——使用此特徵時請小心。此外，黃色道路標線在歐洲非常罕見。

text: Interstate highways, US highways, and some state roads have **rumble strips** on each edge of the road, which are small indentations in the pavement perpendicular to the road. These can be located on the outside edges of the road and in between lanes on multi-lane highways.
NOTE: Rumble strips may appear in Canada, but are much more rare.
text_zh: 州際公路、美國國道以及部分州道在道路的每一側邊緣都有**減速震動帶**，這是道路鋪面上垂直於路面的一系列小型凹槽。這些凹槽可以位於道路的外側邊緣，以及多車道公路的車道之間。
注意：減速標線可能會出現在加拿大，但非常罕見。

text: These **rectangular raised pavement markers** are found in the south and west of the US and also in Massachusetts.
text_zh: 這些**長方形突起路標**常見於美國南部和西部，以及麻薩諸塞州。

text: **Snowplowable raised pavement markers** can only be found on highways in the eastern states shown in the image. They are built into the road and somewhat resemble the letter H.
text_zh: **除雪機專用突起路標**僅見於圖片中所示的東部各州高速公路上。它們內嵌於道路中，外形有點像英文字母 H。

text: Rectangular pavement markers **each on the side of the double lines** are commonly found in Georgia, Florida, Texas, and California. Other rectangular RPM states have the RPM between the double lines.
NOTE: Beware of similar patterns in left turn lanes.
text_zh: 位於雙黃線**兩側**的長方形路標常見於喬治亞州、佛羅里達州、德州和加州。其他長方形路標（RPM）州的 RPM 則位於雙黃線之間。
注意：請小心左轉車道中的類似圖樣。

text: Yellow lines with a noticeably **larger gap** in between them are most common in Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Oregon.
NOTE: Wide middle lines can also rarely appear in other states, so consider other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 中間間隔**明顯較大**的黃線最常出現在德州、阿肯色州、路易斯安那州、密西西比州和奧勒岡州。
注意：寬中線在其他州也很少見，因此在猜測之前請先考慮其他線索。

text: A **black stripe** can sometimes be seen in between the two yellow, middle road lines in California.
text_zh: 加州的兩條黃色中間道路標線之間，有時可以看到一條**黑色條紋**。

text: Some small roads in California** **and Kentucky **lack a middle yellow line**; instead only feature solid white lines on each side of the road.
NOTE: This can rarely be seen in other [states](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dJTjThBAHowKFxd59).
text_zh: 加州和肯塔基州的一些小路**缺乏中間黃線**；取而代之的是道路兩側僅有實心白線。
注意：這種情況在其他[州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dJTjThBAHowKFxd59)很少見。

text: Some roads and highways in the state of Kentucky use uniquely-shaped rumble strips that are **thin, relatively long recessed lines** on the very outside edges of the road.
text_zh: 肯塔基州的一些道路和高速公路採用了特殊形狀的減速震動線，這些線是位於道路最外側邊緣上的**較細、相對較長的凹槽線**。

text: Some roads in West Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, and Virginia use middle yellow lines that are thicker than [traditional](https://goo.gl/maps/sawqJcR8YeWq3Pzr6) yellow road lines.
NOTE: These are not present on all roads in these states, and can be found elsewhere so use this tip in conjunction with other clues.
text_zh: 西維吉尼亞州、馬里蘭州、德拉瓦州和維吉尼亞州的一些道路採用比[傳統](https://goo.gl/maps/sawqJcR8YeWq3Pzr6)黃色道路標線更粗的中間黃線。
注意：這些標線並非存在於這些州的所有道路上，且在其他地方也能找到，因此請將此技巧與其他線索結合使用。

text: **Concrete paving **on **regular roads** is much more common in Iowa than in other states.
Do not trust if it is a [bridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7cicwiNr6GfHErhF9), a [highway](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4h3ogNvAfu3HchU47), or it is in a [city](https://goo.gl/maps/5EneE9SWMHBwooov8).
text_zh: 在**一般道路**上使用**混凝土鋪面**在愛荷華州比其他州常見得多。
如果這是一座[橋樑](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7cicwiNr6GfHErhF9)、[高速公路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4h3ogNvAfu3HchU47)，或是位於[城市](https://goo.gl/maps/5EneE9SWMHBwooov8)中，請勿盲目相信。

text: Road lines in Argentina are mainly dashed** white**, double** yellow** or a mix in between.
text_zh: 阿根廷的道路標線主要為虛線**白色**、雙**黃線**或兩者混合。

text: Australia uses almost exclusively **white road lines**, with a few rare exceptions in alpine regions such as Mount Kosciuszko and Mount Hotham.

NOTE: If you are considering guessing in Australia, but see yellow outside lines or a yellow middle line, you will probably be in South Africa or New Zealand respectively. Note that New Zealand can have all white road lines as well.
text_zh: 澳洲幾乎只使用**白色道路標線**，只有少數例外是在高山地區，例如 Mount Kosciuszko 和 Mount Hotham。
注意：如果你考慮猜澳洲，但看到黃色的外側標線或黃色的中央標線，你很可能分別是在南非或紐西蘭。請注意，紐西蘭也可能全部都是白色道路標線。

text: Outside lines in Australia sometimes feature **rumble strips** that look like small white stripes perpendicular to the road line.
NOTE: Northern Territory roads very rarely have rumble strips.
In addition, you can find similar rumble strips in New Zealand.
text_zh: 澳洲的外側標線有時會出現**減速標線**，這些標線看起來像與道路標線垂直的小白條。
注意：北領地的道路非常少見減速標線。
此外，你也可以在紐西蘭找到類似的減速標線。

text: The Nullarbor Highway (Latin for “no tree”) can be easily recognized thanks to the flatness, overall grey look and **very low vegetation**.
NOTE: Use the road angle or road lines to determine whether you are on the WA or SA side.
text_zh: 納拉伯公路（Nullarbor Highway，拉丁文意為「無樹」）因地形平坦、整體呈灰色調以及**非常矮小的植被**而很容易辨認。
註：利用道路角度或道路標線來判斷你是在西澳還是南澳這一側。

text: Dorat Road (23) in the Northern Territory can be easily recognized thanks to its distinct Darwin area landscape and **lack** of road lines.
text_zh: 北領地的 Dorat Road (23) 很容易辨認，這要歸功於其獨特的達爾文地區景觀以及**缺乏**道路標線。

text: The Sturt Highway from Wentworth to Wagga Wagga can have **triple **broken centre lines.
NOTE: Triple broken centre lines can also be found on other major roads in NSW, such as the Gwydir Highway. However, they are most common on the Sturt Highway.
text_zh: 從溫特沃斯（Wentworth）到瓦加瓦加（Wagga Wagga）的斯圖爾特公路（Sturt Highway）可能劃有**三條 **虛線中央線。
註：三條虛線中央線也可以在新南威爾斯州的其他主要道路上找到，例如葛威迪公路（Gwydir Highway）。不過，它們在斯圖爾特公路上最常見。

text: All-**yellow **road lines can be seen on roads around Mount Kosciuszko.
In addition, a unique white truck with a **snorkel**, and cab guard can be found.
NOTE: All yellow road lines can also be found in other alpine areas in Victoria and New South Wales, so make sure to look at the landscape and other clues.
text_zh: 科斯丘斯科山周圍的道路上可以看到全**黃色 **道路標線。
此外，還能看到一輛帶有**涉水管**和駕駛室防護欄的獨特白色卡車。
註：全黃色道路標線也可以在維多利亞州和新南威爾斯州的其他高山地區看到，因此請務必觀察景觀和其他線索。

text: Belgium uses all **white **road lines. These can be continuous or broken. Roads are often accompanied by** bike lanes** on both sides.
NOTE: Bikes and cycling lanes are most common in the Netherlands, but they can be often seen in Belgium as well.
text_zh: 比利時全部使用**白色**道路標線。這些標線可以是實線或虛線。道路兩側通常伴有**自行車道**。
備註：自行車和自行車道在荷蘭最常見，但在比利時也很常見。

text: Most roads in Bermuda contain a **single solid yellow middle line** with no outer road lines.
text_zh: 百慕達的大多數道路都只有**單條黃色實線中線**，沒有外側道路標線。

text: You will occasionally see these white **zig zag road lines** on Bermuda.
text_zh: 在百慕達你偶爾會看到這種白色的**鋸齒狀道路標線**。

text: **Middle road lines** can be all-yellow, yellow and white, or all-white, while **outer road lines** are always white.

NOTE: Road lines in Chile are always all-white or all-yellow, never a combination of the two. In Peru, you can find roads having outer lines with no middle line. Such outer line-only roads are very rare in Bolivia.
text_zh: **道路中線**可以是全黃色、黃白相間或全白色，而**外側道路標線**則永遠是白色。
注意：智利的道路標線永遠是全白或全黃，絕不會是兩者組合。在秘魯，你可以找到有外側線但沒有中線的道路。這種只有外側線的道路在玻利維亞非常罕見。

text: Like the other countries in Southern Africa, outside road lines (if present) are **yellow**, while centre road lines are **white**.
NOTE: Outside yellow road lines in arid environments also exist in Israel, Palestine, Jordan, and the UAE. However, these countries all drive on the right side.
text_zh: 與非洲南部的其他國家一樣，外側道路標線（若有）為**黃色**，而中央道路標線為**白色**。
註：乾旱環境中的外側黃色道路標線也存在於以色列、巴勒斯坦、約旦和阿拉伯聯合大公國。然而，這些國家都是靠右行駛。

text: The mostly unpaved road north of Maun to Khwai can be identified by **extremely white sandy soil and tall green trees** surrounding the road. The first section of the road, between Maun and Shorobe, is paved. But that section can still be identified by the trees, faint road markings, and power lines to the west of the road.
text_zh: 從馬烏恩以北通往 Khwai 的大部分未鋪設道路，可透過道路周圍**極為白皙的沙質土壤與高大的綠樹**來辨認。該道路的第一段（馬烏恩與 Shorobe 之間）已鋪設柏油。但該路段仍可透過樹木、模糊的道路標線以及道路西側的電線來辨認。

text: Roads have dashed or solid **yellow middle road lines**. Outer road lines are somewhat rare, but when present, they are solid white.
NOTE: Thailand uses similar road lines.
text_zh: 道路中央有虛線或實線的**黃色道路標線**。外側道路標線較少見，但如果有出現，則是白實線。
注意：泰國也使用類似的道路標線。

text: The **southern section of Road 76**, south of Krong Saen Monourom, has recognizable coverage: overcast weather, dark asphalt, the presence of outer road lines, and relatively crisp lines for Cambodian standards. Furthermore, a large part of the eastern half of this road runs through hilly terrain with dense jungle.
text_zh: Krong Saen Monourom 以南的 **76 號道路南段**具有易辨認的街景覆蓋：陰天、深色柏油、有外側道路標線，且以柬埔寨標準來說標線相當清晰。此外，這條道路東半部的大部分路段穿過帶有密林的丘陵地形。

text: **Route 430 **on Newfoundland runs in a roughly south-southwest to north-northeast direction, with the road lines slightly washed out. It is located in a remote and sparsely populated part of the island. On many sections of the road, the coast is visible to your west. To your east, you will usually see low **balsam fir** forests, and occasionally an imposing [wall of mountains](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.81276,-57.8695694,3a,90y,101.84h,97.1t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sR6Wwvxu7AYQ_tISVDbXjzg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) in the far distance.
text_zh: 紐芬蘭島上的**430號公路**（Route 430）大致呈南南西至北北東走向，道路標線稍微有些褪色。它位於該島偏遠且人口稀疏的地區。在這條路的許多路段，往西可以看見海岸。往東通常會看到低矮的**膠冷杉**（balsam fir）森林，遠處偶爾還能看到壯觀的[山牆](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.81276,-57.8695694,3a,90y,101.84h,97.1t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sR6Wwvxu7AYQ_tISVDbXjzg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)。

text: Chilean road lines are either **all white**, or **all yellow**:
- All white road lines are most common. Within the Americas, they are a good clue for Chile, though not completely unique.
- All yellow road lines are seen in National Parks or areas of high snowfall. Within the Americas, these all yellow road lines are essentially unique to Chile.
You will almost **never** see a combination of the two colours, apart from a few rare exceptions.
NOTE: It is important to note that Argentina has a decent amount of roads with all white road lines.
text_zh: 智利的道路標線**全部為白色**，或是**全部為黃色**：
- 全白道路標線最為常見。在美洲大陸內，它們是智利很好的線索，雖然並非完全獨有。
- 全黃道路標線見於國家公園或降雪量大的地區。在美洲大陸內，這些全黃道路標線基本上是智利特有的。
除了少數罕見例外，你幾乎**絕不會**看到這兩種顏色的組合。
注意：必須注意的是，阿根廷有相當數量的道路擁有全白道路標線。

text: In Recreational Park Los Manantiales, just southwest of Poás, you can find a road lined with sugarcane plantations and [cornstalk dracaena](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dracaena_fragrans) plants.
text_zh: 在位於波阿斯（Poás）西南方的洛斯馬南蒂亞萊斯休閒公園（Recreational Park Los Manantiales），你可以找到一條兩旁種滿甘蔗園與[玉米竹蕉](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dracaena_fragrans)植物的道路。

text: **Dashed blue lines** between the outer and inner road markings can be seen on a few roads around Mount Olympus.
text_zh: 奧林帕斯山（Mount Olympus）周圍的一些道路上，可以看到外側和內側道路標線之間有**藍色虛線**。

text: Czechia often has **solid outer roadlines**, with no centre line.
NOTE: While these roadlines can be found in all neighbouring countries, it is notably also common in Germany.
text_zh: 捷克通常有**外側實線道路標線**，沒有中央線。
注意：雖然這些道路標線在所有鄰國都能找到，但在德國也特別常見。

text: Denmark has all-white road lines. **Double middle lines** are very common.
NOTE: Some other European countries, most notably Poland and Greece, can have double middle lines.
text_zh: 丹麥擁有全白的道路標線。**雙中線**非常常見。
注意：其他一些歐洲國家，最顯著的是波蘭和希臘，也可能有雙中線。

text: Outer road lines often consist of **small white squares**. These unique-looking lines are a good way to identify Denmark.
text_zh: 外側道路標線通常由**小型白色方塊**組成。這些外觀獨特的標線是識別丹麥的好方法。

text: Outer road lines sometimes consist of **short dashes**.
NOTE: Lithuania also sometimes has short dashes.
!!In addition, Sweden primarily uses short dashes as outer road lines.
text_zh: 道路外側標線有時由**短虛線**組成。
注意：立陶宛有時也會使用短虛線。
!!此外，瑞典主要也將短虛線作為道路外側標線。

text: Eswatini typically uses **yellow **outside lines and occasionally, **triple white **middle lines.
NOTE: Similar road lines can also be found in South Africa, Lesotho and Botswana.
text_zh: 史瓦帝尼通常使用**黃色**外側線，偶爾會使用**三條白色**的中線。
注意：類似的道路標線也可以在南非、賴索托和波札那找到。

text: Where present, outer road lines will always be **solid white lines**.
NOTE: Unlike Sweden and Norway, Finland does not use dashed outside lines. The only exception to this are the Åland Islands in southwest Finland, which do use dashes.
text_zh: 若有設置，外側道路標線一定會是**實線白線**。
註記：不同於瑞典和挪威，芬蘭不使用虛線外側標線。唯一的例外是位於芬蘭西南部的奧蘭群島，該處確實使用虛線。

text: Finland has several different types of **middle road lines**, including:
- [white dashes](https://goo.gl/maps/yQ7mJwXhJez2CDKa6), with or without a solid white line next to it
- [solid yellow with white dashes](https://goo.gl/maps/USv1DEYbXfne7ZsVA)
- [double yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/U3WZ4fLRZUEjuZFp8).
Yellow lines are being phased out and are increasingly rare in newer coverage.
NOTE: Sweden never has yellow middle lines. Norway has middle lines that have a distinct [orange tint](https://goo.gl/maps/pBepFW6otTJTFaDn6).
text_zh: 芬蘭有多種不同的**中線道路標線**，包括：
- [白色虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/yQ7mJwXhJez2CDKa6)，旁邊可能有或沒有實線白色道路標線
- [黃實線搭配白虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/USv1DEYbXfne7ZsVA)
- [雙黃線](https://goo.gl/maps/U3WZ4fLRZUEjuZFp8)。
黃色標線正在逐漸被淘汰，在較新的街景覆蓋中越來越少見。
注意：瑞典從不使用黃色中央標線。挪威的中央標線帶有明顯的[橘色調](https://goo.gl/maps/pBepFW6otTJTFaDn6)。

text: Åland roads have two unique aspects that separate them from the rest of Finland: their pavement tends to have a **red tint**, and they have **dashed** outside road lines that resemble those found in Sweden.
text_zh: 奧蘭的道路有兩個獨特之處，使它們與芬蘭其他地區區分開來：它們的路面通常帶有**紅色調**，並且它們擁有類似於瑞典道路的**虛線**外側道路標線。

text: Road lines in Ghana are **always white**. However, many paved roads do not have road lines at all.
text_zh: 迦納的道路標線**永遠是白色的**。然而，許多鋪面道路完全沒有道路標線。

text: The road connecting the town of Sawla with the N10 has very crisp,** new road lines**. Most of the road runs in a general east-west direction, through a lush savannah landscape. The middle line can be solid or dashed.
NOTE: There are a couple of other roads with crisp road lines like these, however these tend to have a different road angle or landscape.
text_zh: 連接索瓦鎮（Sawla）和 N10 公路的道路有非常清晰的**新道路標線**。這條路大致呈東西走向，穿過鬱鬱蔥蔥的熱帶草原景觀。中間的標線可以是實線或虛線。
註：還有其他幾條道路也有像這樣清晰的道路標線，但這些道路通常有不同的道路角度或景觀。

text: **Yellow road lines** are more common in Greece than any other southern European country.
text_zh: **黃色道路標線**在希臘比任何其他南歐國家都要常見。

text: Similarly to Mexico, Guatemalan roads generally have solid white outer lines with a **single yellow middle line**. Road lines in Guatemala are generally significantly **thinner** than in [Mexico](https://www.google.com/maps/@15.684137,-92.0520015,3a,67.2y,89.22h,61.96t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sAWSMGxU5u0okOM9sg-Ah0g!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 與墨西哥類似，瓜地馬拉的道路通常有實心的白色外側線以及**單一黃色中線**。瓜地馬拉的道路標線通常比[墨西哥](https://www.google.com/maps/@15.684137,-92.0520015,3a,67.2y,89.22h,61.96t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sAWSMGxU5u0okOM9sg-Ah0g!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)明顯**更細**。

text: While Hungarian road lines are all-white, lines on **bicycle lanes** are typically **yellow**.
text_zh: 雖然匈牙利的道路標線全都是白色的，但**自行車道**上的標線通常是**黃色**的。

text: Iceland has **all-white** road lines. Outside lines, if present, can be either solid or, more rarely, dashed lines.
NOTE: Iceland has no yellow road lines. If you see yellow road lines in a Nordic environment, consider Norway or Finland.
text_zh: 冰島的道路標線皆為**白色**。外側線若存在，可以是實線，或是較罕見的虛線。
注意：冰島沒有黃色道路標線。如果你在北歐環境中看到黃色道路標線，請考慮挪威或芬蘭。

text: Parts of roads NH6 and NH206 southeast of Shillong can be recognised by the presence of khasi pines with distinct **yellow outer road lines** and fresh dark pavement.
NOTE: This is the only road in Meghalaya that uses yellow outer road lines, but these [lines](https://goo.gl/maps/WVhAoJzbH15AGQoG6) exist in other states as well.
text_zh: 西隆東南部的 NH6 和 NH206 公路部分路段可以透過擁有明顯**黃色外側道路標線**和新鮮深色路面的卡西松樹來辨認。
注意：這是梅ઘ拉亞省唯一使用黃色外側道路標線的公路，但這些[標線](https://goo.gl/maps/WVhAoJzbH15AGQoG6)也存在於其他省份。

text: In and around urban areas, you will sometimes encounter **double yellow road lines** on the sides of marked roads. These indicate a no parking zone, and are also very common in the UK. They are not really found anywhere else in Europe apart from Malta, but landscape should be sufficient to tell it apart.
text_zh: 在市區及周邊地區，你有時會在標線道路的側邊遇到**雙黃道路標線**。這些標線代表禁止停車區，在英國也非常常見。除了馬爾他之外，它們在歐洲其他地方幾乎找不到，但景觀應該足以將其區分開來。

text: If a very small rural road has **Generation 4** coverage and is located in an unusually **hilly** landscape, you are likely to be in Donegal.

Note that this meta only applies to the smallest roads: thin, without road lines, and sometimes with grass in the middle. This type of coverage is also not exclusive to Donegal, it is just likely to be there.
text_zh: 如果一條非常小的鄉間小路有**第四代**相機的街景覆蓋，且位於異常**多山**的地景中，你很可能就在多尼戈爾（Donegal）。
請注意，這個特徵線索僅適用於最小的道路：狹窄、沒有道路標線，有時中間還長著草。這種拍攝畫質也不是多尼戈爾所獨有的，只是很有可能會在那裡遇到。

text: Most roads feature **yellow outer lines** with white centre lines.
text_zh: 大多數道路都配有**黃色外側標線**與白色中心線。

text: Japan has three common variations of road lines. They are as follows:
- The most common being white, solid outer lines with a [dashed white](https://goo.gl/maps/ydLiQ19hdgbTekD86) middle line.
- White solid sidelines with a [yellow solid](https://goo.gl/maps/mPCxbst43hVaZXcP6) middle line.
- White solid sidelines with [yellow and white](https://goo.gl/maps/Vcdsq6sH8EQkhnUp6) middle lines.
While you may find other, more rare combinations, Japan will never have yellow outside road lines.
text_zh: 日本的道路標線主要有三種組合：
- 最常見的是白色實線邊線配[白色虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/ydLiQ19hdgbTekD86)中線。
- 白色實線邊線配[黃色實線](https://goo.gl/maps/mPCxbst43hVaZXcP6)中線。
- 白色實線邊線配[黃白並排](https://goo.gl/maps/Vcdsq6sH8EQkhnUp6)的中線。
雖然偶爾找得到其他罕見組合，但日本絕對不會出現黃色的外側邊線。

text: Roads in Jordan typically feature **yellow outside** and **white middle **lines.
NOTE: Other Middle Eastern countries such as the UAE and Israel can also have these road lines. Make sure to check other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 約旦的道路通常有**黃色外側**和**白色中間**的線條。
註：阿拉伯聯合大公國和以色列等其他中東國家也可能有這些道路標線。在猜測之前，請務必檢查其他線索。

text: The divided section of the **E38** goes **southeast to northwest** from Shymkent to Kyzylorda. The road is made of **asphalt**, and it has **all white road lines**. The landscape varies quite a lot; in the south, it is very [green](https://goo.gl/maps/71g8LgQkJqC4mYJF6) and in the north, it gets [dry, sandy, and shrubby](https://goo.gl/maps/StZ6q6CejmVpK7yg8).
Driving direction: Both ways
text_zh: **E38** 的雙向分隔車道從奇姆肯特到克孜勒奧爾達**由東南向西北**延伸。這條路是**柏油**路面，並有**全白色道路標線**。地景變化相當大；南部非常[綠意盎然](https://goo.gl/maps/71g8LgQkJqC4mYJF6)，北部則變得[乾燥、多沙且有灌木](https://goo.gl/maps/StZ6q6CejmVpK7yg8)。
行車方向：雙向

text: The **A17 **going to Ulytau Region can be recognised by the **bad pavement quality**, where the edges of the road are almost crumbling away, along with the **single white middle road line**, which can be dashed or solid. The landscape itself is a grassy steppe, with some fall coloured trees occasionally lining the roads.
[West of Atasu](https://goo.gl/maps/TdENdhe3WB985Lhi8), the sun is distinctly low on the horizon.
NOTE: A small section east of Atasu has [pristine new pavement](https://goo.gl/maps/XeJe82NWDfF4gH1K9), which has a slight red tint to it.
Driving direction: **Towards **[**Atasu**](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.6874387,71.6576538,13.19z?entry=ttu) from both directions
text_zh: 通往兀魯套州的 **A17 **可以透過**糟糕的鋪面品質**來辨識，道路邊緣幾乎在崩塌，並伴隨著**單一白色中央道路標線**（可能是虛線或實線）。地景本身是草地草原，路旁偶爾點綴著帶有秋色的樹木。
[阿塔苏西方](https://goo.gl/maps/TdENdhe3WB985Lhi8)，太陽明顯在地平線低處。
注意：阿塔苏東方的一小段路擁有[嶄新的 pristine 鋪面](https://goo.gl/maps/XeJe82NWDfF4gH1K9)，帶有一點微紅的色調。
行車方向：從雙向**朝向**[**阿塔苏**](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.6874387,71.6576538,13.19z?entry=ttu)

text: The road north of Zhezqazghan has no road lines. The landscape is **very dry, desolate**, with very limited vegetation** **and slightly hilly. The soil can look very red or orange at times.
The weather is sunny, with a lot of [cumulus clouds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumulus_cloud).
Driving directions: **North **from Nikolskiy
text_zh: 傑茲卡茲甘北方的道路沒有道路標線。地景**非常乾燥、荒涼**，植被非常有限** **且略帶起伏。土壤有時看起來非常紅或橘。
天氣晴朗，有許多[積雲](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumulus_cloud)。
行車方向：自尼科利斯克**向北**

text: The **R260 **road is mostly paved, but not in the best condition; many cracks can be seen, and it** **mostly lacks road lines. The weather is **overcast** and the landscape is a **slightly hilly steppe**, consisting of somewhat yellow grass and reddish soil, which is very evident when the road is [unpaved](https://goo.gl/maps/TdSkNVCsQwfzuWvQ7).

The **R217 **is very similar, but the road is in [better condition](https://goo.gl/maps/gkFt8pTBsvfWYnuq5) and mostly has very [faded dashed white middle road lines](https://goo.gl/maps/sYN29uJEyzQKdJjt7), which are often quite difficult to see. The further east you go, the more [sparse](https://goo.gl/maps/J4zjwGopGaSfr1N3A) the cloud cover gets.
Driving directions: **South **from Atbasar
text_zh: **R260 **道路大體上有鋪面，但狀況不是最好；可以看到許多裂縫，且它** **大部分缺乏道路標線。天氣**陰天**，地景是**略帶起伏的草原**，由微黃的草和帶紅的土壤組成，當道路[未鋪柏油](https://goo.gl/maps/TdSkNVCsQwfzuWvQ7)時這點非常明顯。
**R217 **非常相似，但道路[狀況較好](https://goo.gl/maps/gkFt8pTBsvfWYnuq5)，且大多帶有非常[褪色的白色虛線中央道路標線](https://goo.gl/maps/sYN29uJEyzQKdJjt7)，通常相當難以看清。你越往東走，雲層覆蓋就會越[稀疏](https://goo.gl/maps/J4zjwGopGaSfr1N3A)。
行車方向：自阿特巴薩爾**向南**

text: From Khun-Chi to the [intersection ](https://goo.gl/maps/Q3uwC5qMdDACzx5d7)east of Tokmok, the road uses these road lines with a **wide gap** as a median.
text_zh: 從坤奇到托克馬克（Tokmok）東側的[交叉口](https://goo.gl/maps/Q3uwC5qMdDACzx5d7)，道路採用具有**寬間距**的道路標線作為中央分隔帶。

text: The gap in the road lines gets **thinner** east of that intersection up until this [intersection](https://goo.gl/maps/skcoJg2pJaxbkJHVA) east of Kemin.
text_zh: 過了該交叉口向東一直到凱明（Kemin）東側的這個[交叉口](https://goo.gl/maps/skcoJg2pJaxbkJHVA)，道路標線之間的間距變得**更窄**。

text: Some roads have unique **triple middle lines**, consisting of two solid lines with a dashed line in between.
NOTE: These are also found in the other four southern African countries, but nowhere else in the world.
text_zh: 有些道路有獨特的**三條中間線**，由兩條實線和中間的一條虛線組成。
注意：這些也在其他四個南部非洲國家找到，但在世界上其他任何地方都沒有。

text: Malaysia frequently uses **double white** centre lines on its two-lane roads. It is the only Southeast Asian country to do so.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的雙線道公路經常使用**雙白**中心線。它是東南亞唯一這樣做的國家。

text: The most typical Mexican road lines are white solid outer lines with a **single unbroken yellow middle line**.
NOTE: [Single](https://goo.gl/maps/Dbjb5sJ1xcrQBTof7) broken yellow middle lines and [double](https://goo.gl/maps/L9YSqFc6h79idwkm8) yellow middle lines are also common.
text_zh: 墨西哥最典型的道路標線是白色的實線外線，配上一條**單一未斷的黃色中線**。
注意：[單一](https://goo.gl/maps/Dbjb5sJ1xcrQBTof7)斷續黃色中線和[雙](https://goo.gl/maps/L9YSqFc6h79idwkm8)黃色中線也很常見。

text: **Black tar** on both sides of the yellow centre line can be seen in Sinaloa, Durango, and Guerrero.
NOTE: This is most reliable when the tar is not faded.
text_zh: 黃色中心線兩側都有**黑色柏油**的情況可以在錫納羅亞州（Sinaloa）、杜蘭戈州（Durango）和格雷羅州（Guerrero）看到。
注意：當柏油沒有褪色時，這個線索最為可靠。

text: Most roads in Namibia use single **yellow outer lines **and white centre lines.
NOTE: The other southern African countries also use single yellow outer lines.
text_zh: 納米比亞的大多數道路都使用單條 **黃色外側標線** 和白色中央標線。
注意：其他南部非洲國家也使用單條黃色外側標線。

text: Outer yellow road lines are missing on the following sections of the B1:
- Between Grunau and Keetmanshoop, the landscape becomes hillier, and the road quality deteriorates in general.
- This [small section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/enThcbiWS4e37Xx19) north of Keetmanshoop is cloudy.
- The [third section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YS14ugmHJm9DeBqx5) is between Gibeon and Mariental, which is flat, and goes in a N-NE direction.
text_zh: B1 的以下路段缺少外側黃色道路標線：
- 在格魯瑙和凱特曼斯胡普（Keetmanshoop）之間，地景變得更多山，道路品質整體而言也在惡化。
- 凱特曼斯胡普北側的這個[小路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/enThcbiWS4e37Xx19)有多雲的天氣。
- [第三個路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YS14ugmHJm9DeBqx5)位於吉本（Gibeon）和馬林達爾之間，地勢平坦，大致呈北北東走向。

text: Often fairly **poor quality pavement** with [only white road lines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Jf6P3gTK1pfE144b9), [no road lines at all](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RNMAWUQFhJFheYrK6), or just slightly [faded road lines and red tinted pavement](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JyFSRjp81cNB64Wz6), are all good clues for the C49 in the panhandle. Near the western end, the [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tGh9NAzuqvDdPpjF7) is very low in the sky, and the weather is fully clear.
NOTE: A [small section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vvEApEqhL8fBQX6G6) by Makolonga has good pavement with wide shoulders, so look for the orange patches on the road.
text_zh: 通常品質相當**差的路面**，且[只有白色道路標線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Jf6P3gTK1pfE144b9)、[完全沒有道路標線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RNMAWUQFhJFheYrK6)、或是僅有稍微[褪色的道路標線與帶有紅色的路面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JyFSRjp81cNB64Wz6)，都是狭長地帶中 C49 的好線索。靠近西端時，[太陽](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tGh9NAzuqvDdPpjF7)在天空中的位置非常低，且天氣完全晴朗。
注意：Makolonga 旁的一[小段路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vvEApEqhL8fBQX6G6)擁有良好的路面與寬闊的路肩，所以請注意路面上的橘色補丁。

text: Nepal commonly uses **outer yellow road lines** that are either [dashed](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QEJcARP1NNPetPwS8) or [solid](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sAwmxo23B4o9Hc4m7), with dashed white lines in the middle of bigger roads. Solid outer yellows are very common in eastern Bagmati province.
text_zh: 尼泊爾普遍使用[虛線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QEJcARP1NNPetPwS8)或[實線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sAwmxo23B4o9Hc4m7)的**外側黃色道路標線**，較大道路的中間則為白色虛線。外側黃線在巴格馬蒂省（Bagmati）東部非常普遍。

text: Like most of Europe, the Netherlands has **all-white** road lines. Many roads have dashed outside lines. Sometimes, you can find unique [green middle lines](https://goo.gl/maps/hFMtuu8BBeGNQbiPA).
text_zh: 就像大多數歐洲國家一樣，荷蘭的道路標線**全為白色**。許多道路的外側標線是虛線。有時候，你可以找到獨特的[綠色中線](https://goo.gl/maps/hFMtuu8BBeGNQbiPA)。

text: New Zealand normally uses [**white outer**](https://goo.gl/maps/MqhaDyWhXhWWMwfSA)** road lines**. [Yellow dashed outer](https://goo.gl/maps/iwDpkjx7uvAhDnGm9) road lines can be seen in populated areas. Roads with [no outer lines](https://goo.gl/maps/8LJUn5zfzXnHXmZa8) can be seen on smaller roads. Inner lines are either a single dashed white line or unbroken double **yellow **lines.
NOTE: Australia does not have yellow inside lines, apart from regions with snow.
text_zh: 紐西蘭通常使用[**白色外側**](https://goo.gl/maps/MqhaDyWhXhWWMwfSA)**道路標線**。在人口稠密的地區可以看到[黃色虛線外側](https://goo.gl/maps/iwDpkjx7uvAhDnGm9)道路標線。較小的道路上可以看到[沒有外側標線](https://goo.gl/maps/8LJUn5zfzXnHXmZa8)的道路。內側標線則是單一白色虛線或連續的雙**黃色**實線。
注意：澳洲內部線條除了有雪的地區外，沒有黃色線條。

text: Smaller Norwegian roads typically have **long dashed** white outer lines, while larger roads have solid outer lines and **yellow middle lines**. The yellow lines have a distinct tinge of orange.

NOTE: Sweden only has white road lines, and the [dashes](https://www.google.se/maps/@55.8603502,14.0645816,3a,67.7y,310.56h,67.2t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sxSuRl8lj2S2ldx_vzphffQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?shorturl=1) on outer lines are shorter than in Norway. [Finnish](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=c8FOHjmvgdL7njxYf5Hb6Q&viewpoint=64.117952,26.646979&heading=97.5109375143503&pitch=-14.532690519627238&fov=56.68574773360253&shorturl=1#extra%5Btags%5D=road+lines) outer road lines are always solid, and middle lines can be yellow or white.
text_zh: 較小的挪威道路通常有**長虛線**的白色外側標線，而較大的道路則有實線外側標線和**黃色中線**。黃色線條帶有明顯的橘色色調。

注意：瑞典只有白色道路標線，且外側標線的[虛線](https://www.google.se/maps/@55.8603502,14.0645816,3a,67.7y,310.56h,67.2t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sxSuRl8lj2S2ldx_vzphffQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?shorturl=1)比挪威短。[芬蘭](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=c8FOHjmvgdL7njxYf5Hb6Q&viewpoint=64.117952,26.646979&heading=97.5109375143503&pitch=-14.532690519627238&fov=56.68574773360253&shorturl=1#extra%5Btags%5D=road+lines)的外側道路標線永遠是實線，中線則可以是黃色或白色。

text: Road lines will often be made up of **small dots** of paint.
text_zh: 道路標線通常由**小圓點**的油漆組成。

text: Masirah Island features a dry and slightly hilly landscape, typically with somewhat grey soil and with [brown shrubs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aKFc2E3KJdkTpbxm9) visible. Road 51, which circulates the island, usually only has a white centre road line, which can help in recognising it. The front camera on the island is [slightly smudged](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ANPz9Zyhb9M2dsdx7).
text_zh: 馬西拉島的特色是乾燥且有些起伏的地形，土壤通常呈灰灰色，並可見[棕色灌木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aKFc2E3KJdkTpbxm9)。環島的 51 號公路通常只有白色中央道路標線，這有助於辨識。島上的前鏡頭[有點模糊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ANPz9Zyhb9M2dsdx7)。

text: This long stretch of Road 31 can be recognised by the light-coloured flat desert landscape along with the **wide shoulders** and the often faded road lines. The weather is usually somewhat cloudy.
text_zh: 這段長距離的 31 號公路可以透過淺色的平坦沙漠景觀以及**寬路肩**和經常褪色的道路標線來識別。天氣通常有點多雲。

text: Peruvian roads always have white outer lines. On highways, you will find either **single yellow dashed** or **double yellow** middle lines. On rural mountain roads, you will most likely see white outer lines without any centre line. On divided highways, the road lines may be [completely white](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VLUf8irrxCGb1hTi8) in colour.
NOTE: In the continent of South America, rural mountain roads, with the features mentioned above, are predominantly found in Peru.
text_zh: 祕魯的道路永遠都有白色外側線。在公路上，你會找到**單黃虛線**或**雙黃**中線。在鄉村山路上，你最常看到的會是沒有任何中心線的白色外側線。在分隔式公路上，道路標線顏色可能是[完全白色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VLUf8irrxCGb1hTi8)的。
注意：在南美洲大陸上，具備上述特徵的鄉村山路主要見於祕魯。

text: **Ruta 28B **between the towns of Kimbiri and Echarate is a paved road with very faded or missing road lines. It is also characterised by being a relatively small road with Generation 4 coverage, which hugs the hillside and is located next to a river valley.
text_zh: 金比里（Kimbiri）和埃恰拉特（Echarate）城鎮之間的 **28B 國道（Ruta 28B）**是一條鋪面道路，道路標線非常褪色或缺失。它的特徵還在於是一條擁有第四代街景覆蓋的相對狹窄道路，緊貼著山腰並位於河谷旁。

text: Middle road lines in the Philippines can be either yellow or white. In particular, you will often see combined **yellow and white** middle lines, which is not common in any other East Asian country.
Yellow road lines commonly have a distinct [**orange tint**](https://goo.gl/maps/vT9Mpun12cRGEgun7).
text_zh: 菲律賓的中央道路標線可以是黃色或白色。特別的是，你常會看到 **黃白** 混合的中央標線，這在其他東亞國家並不常見。
黃色道路標線通常帶有明顯的 [**橘色色調**](https://goo.gl/maps/vT9Mpun12cRGEgun7)。

text: Poland has all-white road lines. **Double middle lines** are very common and usually a good clue for Poland.
NOTE: Some other European countries, most notably Denmark and Greece, can have double middle lines.
text_zh: 波蘭的道路標線全為白色。**雙中線**非常普遍，通常是判斷波蘭的好線索。
注意：其他一些歐洲國家，最明顯的是丹麥和希臘，也可能有雙中線。

text: Middle lines are often noticeably **thicker** than average. This is especially useful to tell Romania apart from Bulgaria, which generally has [thinner road lines](https://goo.gl/maps/6nK1dEjs41bLrkPt5).
text_zh: 中央標線通常明顯比平均**更粗**。這對於將羅馬尼亞與保加利亞區分開來特別有用，保加利亞通常有著[較細的道路標線](https://goo.gl/maps/6nK1dEjs41bLrkPt5)。

text: The 67C is a mountain road with **all** **yellow road lines**.
text_zh: 67C 是一條**全黃色道路標線**的山路。

text: On most roads, South Africa utilizes single **yellow outer lines **and white centre lines.
NOTE: The other southern African countries of Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho and Namibia also use single yellow outer lines.
!!Australia practically never uses yellow outer lines.
text_zh: 在大多數道路上，南非採用單條**黃色外側線**和白色中心線。
註：南部非洲的其他國家波札那、史瓦帝尼、賴索托和納米比亞也使用單條黃色外側線。
!!澳洲幾乎從不使用黃色外側線。

text: South Africa occasionally features unique white **triple centre lines** with 2 solid lines on the outside and a dashed line on the inside.
You may also sometimes encounter another unique triple centre line, consisting of two white lines with one yellow line in the middle. These centre lines are usually found on larger main roads.
NOTE: The only other countries where you will find road lines like these are the other southern African countries of Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho and Namibia.
text_zh: 南非偶爾會出現獨特的白色**三條中心線**，外側為 2 條實線，內側為 1 條虛線。
你可能也會偶爾遇到另一種獨特的三條中心線，由兩條白色線和中間一條黃色線組成。這些中心線通常見於較大的主要道路上。
註：你會找到此類道路標線的僅有其他國家，是同為南部非洲國家的波札那、史瓦帝尼、賴索托和納米比亞。

text: The landscape around Kruger National Park is generally flat, with a **savannah **climate and dry vegetation. You will not see any agriculture and the vegetation is mostly made up of grasses, with small trees dotting the landscape. Red soil can also be seen below the grass.
In addition, this distinctive [directional waystone](https://goo.gl/maps/C4VRQ6v1PyAStJUz7) is commonly found at many junctions.
NOTE: Within the coverage of the park, you will mostly find unpaved gravel roads or small and paved roads without road lines.
text_zh: 克魯格國家公園周邊的景觀通常很平坦，具有**稀樹草原**氣候與乾燥的植被。你看不到任何農業活動，植被主要由草地組成，並散布著小樹。草地下方也能看到紅土。
此外，這個獨特的[方向石碑](https://goo.gl/maps/C4VRQ6v1PyAStJUz7)常見於許多交叉路口。
注意：在公園的街景覆蓋範圍內，你主要會看到未鋪柏油的碎石路，或是沒有道路標線的小型鋪面道路。

text: Rural roads sometimes have **dashed outer lines**. This can help tell Spain apart from Portugal and Italy, where such road lines are (almost) non-existent.
Note that the reverse is not true: like Italy and Portugal, many Spanish roads do have solid outer lines.
text_zh: 農村道路有時會有**虛線外線**。這有助於將西班牙與葡萄牙和義大利區分開來，在後兩者中，此類道路標線（幾乎）是不存在的。
請注意，反過來並不成立：如同義大利和葡萄牙，許多西班牙的道路確實有實線的外側邊線。

text: Rural roads often have **outside lines, but no middle lines**. In the absence of other clues, this can sometimes be a way to decide a tough 50-50.
NOTE: Most small roads lack road lines entirely.
text_zh: 鄉村道路通常有 **外側線，但沒有中線**。在缺乏其他線索的情況下，這有時可以成為在艱難的五五波（50-50）抉擇中做出判斷的方法。
注意：大多數小路完全沒有道路標線。

text: On smaller roads, the outer road lines are white and dashed. They are distinctly shorter than the Norwegian dashed lines. In contrast to Norway and Finland, **all** road lines are **white**.
text_zh: 在較小的道路上，外側道路標線是白色且為虛線。它們明顯比挪威的虛線短。與挪威和芬蘭不同的是，**所有**道路標線都是**白色**的。

text: The outer road lines on highways look solid from a distance, but are typically divided into **small sections** with a unique pattern, which is different from the solid lines in Finland and Norway. Road lines in Denmark can have a similar pattern, however the individual sections should be [rectangular](https://www.google.se/maps/@55.5061429,9.291442,3a,42.1y,351.24h,40.79t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sYXulc4vgLFgZ2YVE8d18gQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192).
text_zh: 高速公路的外側道路標線從遠處看是實線，但通常會分成帶有獨特圖案的**小段**，這與芬蘭和挪威的實線不同。丹麥的道路標線可能也有類似的圖案，不過個別的分段應該是[長方形](https://www.google.se/maps/@55.5061429,9.291442,3a,42.1y,351.24h,40.79t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sYXulc4vgLFgZ2YVE8d18gQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。

text: **Long dashed yellow** road lines are a good clue for Switzerland.
NOTE: These road lines are also common in Liechtenstein.
text_zh: **長而虛線的黃色**道路標線是識別瑞士的好線索。
注意：這些道路標線在列支敦斯登也很常見。

text: Roads with outside white road lines and **no middle lines** at all are common. In the absence of better clues, this type of road line can be a very good way to identify Taiwan.
text_zh: 只有白色邊線、**完全沒有中線**的道路也很常見。在沒有更好線索的情況下，這種標線組合是辨識台灣的有力依據。

text: Tunisia usually has white road lines. Outer road lines can be dashed or solid.
NOTE: A few roads in Sfax have [yellow middle lines](https://goo.gl/maps/VWruqg6L6z9bPFxU6).
text_zh: 突尼西亞通常擁有白色道路標線。外側道路標線可以是虛線或實線。
注意：斯法克斯（Sfax）的一些道路有[黃色中線](https://goo.gl/maps/VWruqg6L6z9bPFxU6)。

text: The colour of Turkish road lines is somewhat inconsistent. Most roads simply have white road lines. However, it is not uncommon to see yellow road lines. These roads can have [fully yellow lines](https://goo.gl/maps/NDYQg17SRma1M8VY9), or a [combination of yellow and white lines](https://goo.gl/maps/kVzg32BeNHnxXNhb8).
text_zh: 土耳其的道路標線顏色有些不一致。大多數道路只有白色的道路標線。然而，看到黃色道路標線也並不少見。這些道路可能有[全黃色的標線](https://goo.gl/maps/NDYQg17SRma1M8VY9)，或是[黃白相間的標線](https://goo.gl/maps/kVzg32BeNHnxXNhb8)。

text: Along the western shore of Lake Beyşehir and [Lake Eğirdir](https://goo.gl/maps/9R4Hc6UMzMLLTn7g6) you can find this small single lane road with jagged, exposed rock and [Turkish pines](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_brutia) to the west. These two can be differentiated by the road west of Lake Eğirdir having a middle road line.
text_zh: 沿着貝伊謝爾湖與[埃吉爾代湖](https://goo.gl/maps/9R4Hc6UMzMLLTn7g6)的西岸，你可以找到這條狹窄的單線道路，西側有崎嶇裸露的岩石和[土耳其赤松](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_brutia)。這兩處的區別在於埃吉爾代湖西側的道路擁有道路中線。

text: **Double yellow road lines** are often found on the sides of marked roads, especially in urban areas. These lines indicate a no stopping zone.
NOTE: These lines can also be found in Ireland.
text_zh: 標示道路的兩側經常可以看到**雙黃線**，特別是在市區。這些線路表示禁止停車區域。
注意：這些線路在愛爾蘭也能找到。

text: Uruguay often has these **triple road lines**, that consist of double yellow roadlines with white dashes in between. This is a design not seen anywhere else in the Americas.
text_zh: 烏拉圭常有這種**三線道路標線**，由雙黃線夾著中間的白色虛線組成。這是美洲其他地方看不到的設計。

text: You can also find two other, non-unique road line patterns:
- Yellow-white lines (also found in Argentina)
- Simple white lines (found in many other places).
text_zh: 你也可以找到另外兩種非獨特的道路標線樣式：
- 黃白線（也在阿根廷找到）
- 單純白線（在許多其他地方找到）。

text: While multiple different types of road lines, both white and yellow, can be found in Vietnam, unusually **short yellow middle dashes** are particularly common and distinct.
text_zh: 雖然在越南可以找到多種不同類型的道路標線（包括白色和黃色），但異常**短的黃色中間虛線**特別常見且顯著。

intro.lead: 道路標線的顏色組合是最快的洲別判斷
body: 看中線與邊線的顏色搭配：黃色中線常見於美洲與日韓、白色中線常見於歐洲與大洋洲，邊線有沒有、是實線還是虛線也有差異。
各國的標線組合在國家頁的速查欄有圖示可直接對照。這一類全是文字說明沒有圖片，因為標線是用顏色序列描述而不是照片。
